label: The specified four-world model has epistemic S5 blocks {0,1},{2},{3}, modal S5 blocks {0,2},{1,3}…
paraphrase: The specified four-world model has epistemic S5 blocks {0,1},{2},{3}, modal S5 blocks {0,2},{1,3}, actuality0 and atom true at0,2. Factivity and full conjunct extraction hold. Its atom-invariant family contains the atom, constants and Boolean combinations; every member satisfies globally biconditional knowability, yet the atom is actually true and unknown and its Moore conjunction is inadmissible. Epistemic alternatives are not contained in modal alternatives. This is a formal rival, not actual human knowledge or a refutation of all antirealism.
